description: He keeps going in and out of the litter box since last night and nothing comes out. He cries when he squats and he keeps licking himself down there. His belly feels hard and he did not touch his food this morning.
He collapsed in the yard about twenty minutes ago and now he is breathing with his mouth wide open and his neck stretched out. His gums look bluish. He will not get up when I call him.
She has been scratching her back and sides for about two weeks. There are a few bald patches near her tail. She is eating normally, drinking normally and still wants to play.
She seems off today. Not her usual self since we came back from my cousin's house yesterday.
The cat has been sneezing for three days and has a little clear fluid at the nose. She is eating and playing as usual.
He has vomited twice since last night and will not drink water. He is quiet but still wags his tail when we speak to him.
She has been scratching her ears a lot this week and shakes her head. She is bright and eating well.
The puppy has had loose stools since yesterday morning but is playful and eating his meals.
He is licking one paw more than usual and walks with a slight limp. He still jumps onto the couch and eats well.
She was hit by a motorbike a few minutes ago. She is lying on her side and crying out when we try to move her.
